name: Tai-Amura
source:
Tai-Amura is the kindest of Beexen’s ghosts and the most loyal toward the Believer princess of Dreamsted. Her ability lies in psychological manipulation—she breaks her victims through doubts and memories. Tai-Amura easily falls into hysteria when her target manages to resist her powers.

Tai-Amura emerged from Beexen’s heart as the personification of her nostalgia, namely from her sorrow for the past, when her mother, Queen Beenerdim, was still alive. By the beginning of the game’s events, he resides in the Aquiles Forest, where he lures his victims.
